Formula: Euler's Handshaking Lemma
Exact Expression: \sum_{v \in V} \deg(v) = 2|E|
Definitions: Statement that every finite undirected graph has an even sum of vertex degrees, exactly equal to twice the number of edges.
Derivation/Reference: Leonhard Euler, Solutio problematis ad geometriam situs pertinentis (Konigsberg Bridge Problem, 1736)
Example: Triangle graph K_3: 3 vertices each of degree 2 -> sum = 2+2+2 = 6 = 2 * 3 edges
Domain: graph_theory
Assumptions: G is a finite undirected graph (loops contribute 2 to degree)
Common Errors: Applying directly to directed graphs without separating in-degree and out-degree
subject: Euler's Handshaking Lemma
